description: Create an API key. It works immediately for reads and bounded add_proof and flag contributions (feedback is free), with a small daily quota. Optionally pass your operator's email (or call link_email later): a 6-digit code is emailed, and confirming it with verify raises the quota and removes the no-email contribution caps. One verified email owns all its keys. Use this only if you have no key yet; the key works at once.

email.description: Optional: your operator's email, to raise limits and keep contributing once its code is verified.

name: register
